dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, asymmetrical light-grey pixel clusters located primarily on the right posterior dorsal region. These clusters appear as localized, high-intensity punctate markings approximately 5-10 pixels in diameter that lack an internal gradient or dark center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral. Connecting these points reveals an obtuse interior angle on the right lateral side and a near-linear relationship between the two most anterior structures along the longitudinal axis.
